svg.title: Fraud Shield data flow diagram
svg.desc: Seven-stage pipeline from operator browser input through transaction validation, behavior analysis, feature engineering, ML prediction, risk scoring, and persistence, with side connections to behavior profile store, model artifacts, and runtime JSON store.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain the parse_transaction() validation logic in app.py')
sendPrompt('Explain how analyze_behavior() computes behavior signals and risk points')
sendPrompt('Explain engineer_single_transaction() and the 15 model features')
sendPrompt('Explain the ML prediction step: StandardScaler and Random Forest threshold')
sendPrompt('Explain calculate_risk() and create_alert_if_needed() in app.py')
sendPrompt('Explain update_behavior_profile() and save_state() persistence logic')
sendPrompt('Explain the BEHAVIOR_PROFILES in-memory store structure')
sendPrompt('What is stored in fraud_model.pkl and scaler.pkl?')
